valuation.method: Forward EPS x P/E: FY2027 non-GAAP diluted EPS viewed at the 12-month target date (Nov 2027), times a justified P/E. USD listing, no ADR conversion. FY2026 anchor: revenue guidance $91-92B and non-GAAP EPS guidance $35.00-$36.00 (which absorbs about $4.57/share of Q3 acquired IPR&D, so underlying FY2026 EPS is roughly $40). FY2027 EPS is my own assumption (no IPR&D charge beyond a normal run-rate); consensus FY2027 EPS was not sourced.

bear.driver: Tirzepatide price erosion and slower volume as Medicare/Medicaid pricing and competition (oral and next-gen GLP-1s) cut growth; repeat IPR&D charges.

base.driver: Revenue grows about 25% in 2027 on Mounjaro/Zepbound volume with modest net price decline; operating leverage offsets IPR&D run-rate; tax 19-20% per guidance.

bull.driver: Revenue growth above 30% with orforglipron launch and wider obesity coverage, margin expansion.

valuation.implied_by_close: At base EPS of $48 the $1,443.50 close implies 30.1x; the analyst target average of about $1,600 (Scotiabank, Morgan Stanley) implies 33.3x at $48, or about $51.6 EPS at 31x.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $48 (about 3.3 pp of the close).
valuation.watch_metric: Combined Mounjaro and Zepbound quarterly revenue (Q3 2026: $10.7B and $5.35B) and net price per script, plus 2027 non-GAAP EPS guidance.
valuation.next_disclosure: Q4 and FY2026 results with initial 2027 guidance, expected around early February 2027 (date not confirmed).

analyst_notes: Only two named analysts (Scotiabank, Morgan Stanley) were sourced with dated calls, both raising targets on Oct 30 after the Q3 beat and guidance raise (Scotiabank $1,300 to $1,605, Morgan Stanley $1,430 to $1,596). Both sit about 11% above the close and about 7-8% above my base case, equivalent to about $51-52 of FY2027 EPS at 31x or roughly 33x on my $48. Jefferies ($1,610 to $1,700, Nov 9), Argus, Wells Fargo and UBS/BMO/Leerink moves were seen only in search snippets without named analysts, and a Barclays raise to $1,550 dated Nov 16 falls after the reference close, so all are excluded. Horizon is unknown for both targets, so they stay out of the weighted target.
